core_meaning.primary_meaning: Radiyah is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Content, pleased”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Radiyah corresponds to the Arabic form رَضِيَّة (Arabic root ر ض و (r-ḍ-w); رَضِيَّة (Raḍiyya)). Its core sense is radiyah; content, pleased (feminine). Radiyah is Arabic رَضِيَّة (Raḍiyya) 'content, pleased' (feminine), from the root ر ض و (r-ḍ-w). The source gloss 'Rejoicing, Delightful' is broadly consistent. Same name as radhia.

etymology.etymology_explanation: The form رَضِيَّة is an established Arabic lexical item, and Radiyah is the word itself used as a personal name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
etymology.false_etymology_warning: No derivation beyond the documented Arabic form is asserted. Any etymology that attributes this spelling to a different root or language without a source should be treated as unverified.

persian.name: رضیه
persian.long_meaning: Radiyah (رضیه) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن رضیه، خرسند است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: रज़िया
hindi.long_meaning: Radiyah (रज़िया) अरबी भाषा से लिया गया नाम है। इसका मुख्य अर्थ रज़िया, संतुष्ट है। यह नाम मुस्लिम समाजों में रखा जाता है और इसका प्रयोग संदर्भ के अनुसार बदलता है।

pashto.name: رضیه
pashto.long_meaning: Radiyah (رضیه) د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی او بنسټیزه مانا یې رضیه، قناعت کوونکې ده. دا نوم په مسلمانانو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او کارونه یې د سیاق له مخې بدلیږي.

arabic.name: رَضِيَّة
arabic.long_meaning: Radiyah (رَضِيَّة) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي رَضِيَّة، الرَّاضِيَة. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

faq.q: What is the origin of Radiyah?

faq.q: What is the root of Radiyah?
faq.a: It is built on the root ر ض و (r-ḍ-w).
Radiyah is used by Muslims, but it is a lexical name rather than an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Radiyah is not independently established as a Qur'anic personal name.

faq.a: In Urdu it is written رضیہ and carries the sense “رضیہ، مطمئن”.

faq.a: Documented usage records Radiyah as a girl's name; actual use can vary by community.
